To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the total synthesis of (-) - agelastatin A has been accomplished in 12 steps from the chiral starting material (-)-3.
the synthesis of (-)-1 was achieved by an intramolecular Michael addition of a pyrrolinone to a chiral enone followed by a bromination of the pyrrole ring.
a new total synthesis of agelastatin A has been achieved from an oxazolidinyl chiral pool precursor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of natural products, especially those of biological interest, and the development of new methods for organic synthesis.
the synthesis of complex molecules of biological and medicinal interest.
the total synthesis of marine natural products and their analogs with the goal of providing insight into the structure activity relationship of these molecules.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the new synthetic route to agelastatin A has been developed.
the total synthesis of agelastatin A is complete.
the total synthesis of (-)agelastatin was achieved in 13 steps and 6.3% overall yield from the chiral starting material (-)-3.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an enone transposition methodology that is complementary to the previously developed enone transposition method.
the total synthesis of (-)-(1) has been accomplished from the oxazolidinones (-)-3 and (+)-4, and the total syntheses of (+)-(1) and (+)-2 have been accomplished from the same chiral oxazolinones.
the key to success in this total synthesis was to use the Michael ring closure to construct the pyrrole ring and to use the bromination of the pyrrole nitrogen to effect transposition of the enone.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the enone transposition reaction of the 2-oxo-3-pyrrolidinone is highly substrate dependent.

the synthesis of the agelastatin family of alkaloids can be achieved in a straightforward manner by the use of the chiral oxzolidinone (-)3 as a chiral precursor.
